messages:
Ellie: Heads up, I'm in Amsterdam De Pijp next week. Looking for morning pastries for a small all-hands (8 people) and a casual lunch spot for 12 after. Prefer veggie options, max ~€20/head for lunch. Any quick recs?

Ravi: Bakkerswinkel is solid for pastries, sit-down and great coffee. Portions small but nicest pastries in the area.

Sanne: Try Stach on Ferdinand Bolstraat for grab-and-go croissants and oat milk lattes. They do boxes if you call ahead.

Tom: For lunch, De Pijp has "Foodhallen" nearby—lots of stalls, good for groups. Veg options and comfy for people who want different things.

Asha: Also recommend "Dapp Friet" for fries and veggie snacks, cheap and always a hit post-meeting.

Ellie: Nice. Can Foodhallen do reservations for 12 or is it walk-in?

Tom: It's mostly walk-in but some vendors take group orders. If you want seated area, book "Sir Hummus" around the corner, great for veg, family-style plates ~€18-22pp.

Ravi: If you want to keep budget low, get pastry boxes from Stach for the morning + shareable mezze at Sir Hummus for lunch.

Sanne: Pro tip: order pastry boxes by 6pm previous day to avoid a morning scramble.

Ellie: Vote with emoji: 1) Foodhallen stroll + Stach pastries :one:, 2) Sir Hummus booking + Bakkerswinkel pastries :two:, 3) Pastry boxes + Dapp Friet casual :three:

Tom: :one: from me, easier logistics.

Asha: :two: feels nicer for team lunch.

Ravi: :three: if you want super cheap and fast.

Ellie: OK looks like split but leaning Foodhallen. I'll reserve pastry boxes with Stach and message logistics. Thanks y'all!

OpsBot: Reminder: group meal expenses for team offsites need pre-approval if >€100. File a quick request in #finance-ops. :bookmark_tabs:

Ellie: Will do. Ping me if you want to join the tasting walk on Tue evening :)
